title.zh: DTCC代币化服务上线，首批支持25种证券
title.en: DTCC tokenization service launches with initial 25 securities

current_state.zh: DTCC's tokenization service launched with an initial 25 securities representing about $30 trillion in underlying DTC-custodied assets, offering 1:1 CUSIP-matched tokens, 24/7 compliant wallet transfers, and on-chain Treasury payment servicing on Canton Network and private Besu, with Stellar and Circle Arc planned for 2027.
current_state.en: DTCC's tokenization service launched with an initial 25 securities representing about $30 trillion in underlying DTC-custodied assets, offering 1:1 CUSIP-matched tokens, 24/7 compliant wallet transfers, and on-chain Treasury payment servicing on Canton Network and private Besu, with Stellar and Circle Arc planned for 2027.

updates.what_changed_zh: DTCC's tokenization service went live with 25 tokenizable securities backed by about $30 trillion in DTC-custodied assets, issuing 1:1 CUSIP-matched tokens with compliance transfer restrictions on Canton Network and its private Besu chain, with Stellar and Circle's Arc to follow in 2027.
